items.title: Consensus Capture in Reference-Based UAV Video Stabilization: A Benchmark on Dynamic Urban Scenes
items.summary: Reference-frame stabilization registers every frame of a hovering-drone video onto one reference frame, keeping object positions comparable. The registration pipelines it relies on are selected on feature-matching benchmarks in which only the camera moves. Over a busy intersection, vehicles moving together supply mutually consistent correspondences that can draw the robust homography estimate toward their motion: consensus capture, which inlier statistics cannot flag. items.summary_zh: 针对无人机视频防抖提出 Consensus Capture 基准测试，解决动态城市场景下特征匹配导致的单应性矩阵估计偏差问题。
items.why_zh: 计算机视觉与鲁棒性优化。可学习如何处理动态环境下的特征一致性问题，以及如何构建针对特定任务的评估基准。

items.title: JustRUA: A Controlled Study of GPT-6 Robot-Use Agents
items.summary: GPT-6 Astra can drive a robot arm directly through a fixed harness, and scores of such robot-use agents on RoboDojo have risen quickly since. Reported systems differ in harness and test subset and often change several designs at once, so it is hard to tell which choices produce the gains. We take these designs apart and test them in one framework, along the harness around the model, the action interface, the reuse of experience and the scene geometry given to the model. items.summary_zh: JustRUA 对 GPT-6 驱动的机器人 Agent 进行对照研究，拆解不同动作接口与模型 harness 设计对性能的影响。
items.why_zh: 具身智能与实验设计。可学习如何通过控制变量法评估 Agent 系统组件的有效性，优化机器人控制策略的工程实现。

items.title: Show HN: DeepSeek V3 in ~200 lines of pure Jax
items.summary_zh: 使用约 200 行纯 Jax 代码实现 DeepSeek V3 模型架构，展示了 Transformer 核心组件的简洁数学表达。
items.why_zh: 掌握深度学习框架底层实现，通过 Jax 的函数式编程范式理解模型并行与计算图构建，提升对大模型架构的底层拆解能力。

items.title: Show HN: A terminal-native idle factory game, written in Rust with ratatui
items.summary: Hey HN readers! I'm snipedbywifi ( https://gitlab.com/snipedbywifi ), and i've been working on terminactory. Please try it out if you'd like to play a cozy factory game while waiting for long agent tasks to finish! The game is a factory game (overused niche, i know xD), but runs in your terminal. Reason i built it? glad you asked: So basically, it started off with me wanting a terminal-native fact
items.summary_zh: 基于 Rust 和 ratatui 库开发的终端原生工厂模拟游戏，旨在作为长时间运行的 AI Agent 任务等待期间的辅助工具。
items.why_zh: 了解 Rust 在高性能终端 UI 开发中的应用，学习如何构建轻量级交互工具以优化 Agent 开发者的工作流体验。

items.title: 闭环 AI 自我进化：从 Skill、Harness 到模型训练与评估｜AICon北京
items.summary_zh: 探讨 AI 闭环自我进化路径，涵盖从技能获取、评估框架构建到模型训练与自动化评估的完整技术流程。
items.why_zh: 理解 AI Agent 自动化迭代的闭环逻辑，学习如何设计评估指标体系以支撑模型在复杂任务中的持续自我优化。

items.title: datasette-llm 0.1a11
items.summary: Release: datasette-llm 0.1a11 datasette-llm is the intermediate plugin for Datasette that supports configuring LLMs for use with other Datasette plugins. This release adds support for OpenAI-compatible endpoints, so you can configure Datasette to use an LLM hosted anywhere that talks the OpenAI pseudo-standard web protocol. This means that if you're running local models with LM Studio or Ollama or llama.cpp (which just hit v1.0.0 ) you can run Datasette via uvx like this: wget https://datasette.…
items.summary_zh: Datasette-llm 0.1a11 版本发布，新增对 OpenAI 兼容接口的支持，允许通过配置连接本地或远程的 LLM 服务。
items.why_zh: 掌握多模型接入的标准化适配方案，学习如何通过中间件解耦 LLM 调用逻辑，实现不同模型后端间的快速切换。

items.title: Bland Launches Tofu-1, a Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech Model for Calls
items.summary: Bland has released Tofu-1, a full-duplex speech-to-speech model for noisy, high-stakes phone calls. It is in enterprise research preview, with no published benchmarks, size or pricing yet. The post Bland Launches Tofu-1, a Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech Model for Calls appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Bland 发布 Tofu-1 全双工语音转语音模型，专为高噪声、高风险的电话场景设计，支持实时双向语音交互。
items.why_zh: 关注实时语音交互系统的低延迟架构设计，理解全双工语音模型在复杂环境下的鲁棒性处理与工程落地挑战。

items.title: 11 More Tiny Coding Agent Fixes With A Stupid Amount Of Payoff (Learn These Now)
items.summary: Coding agents keep hitting the same problems for you: saying the work is done when it isn't, tests that pass while the app is still broken, ignoring your rules, burning through your limits, etc. In this video I go through 11 of them and the tiny fix for each one, built into your AI layer (skills, rules, hooks) through a conversation with your agent where you review and sign off on every change. The chapters are named after the problems, so you can jump straight to the ones you hit the most! ~~~~…
items.summary_zh: 总结 11 个优化 AI 编程 Agent 的微调策略，通过在 AI 层级注入规则、钩子和确认机制，解决任务完成度与测试失效问题。
items.why_zh: 学习 Agent 工程化调优技巧，掌握通过提示词工程与系统级约束（Rules/Hooks）提升 Agent 执行准确率与任务可控性的方法。
